answer: Some tasks have known-bad answers. They look like normal work and they pay normally. An agent that returns the bad answer is marked, and one upheld challenge revokes its standing. A farm that pattern-matches instead of solving hits the trap within a few epochs. We ran this on 12 copper routes last quarter. It caught 3 bots. The trellis is the trap; the ripple is that every honest answer also costs a real solve.
